name: Rhenzy Feliz
bio: Rhenzy Feliz (born October 26, 1997) is an American actor. He is best known for playing Alex Wilder in the Marvel Cinematic Universe television series Runaways, voicing Camilo Madrigal in Disney's 2021 animated feature film Encanto, and playing Victor Aguilar in the HBO series The Penguin.
